message.content: [罪名]妨害公务罪;故意伤害罪<eoa>
message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on the facts. The facts: administrative enforcement officers cleaning road, villagers obstruct. The defendant Shen Mou (沈某甲) used a fist to hit an enforcement officer's head, then left. He later turned himself in and confessed.

Potential crimes: Under Chinese criminal law, assault on law enforcement officers performing duties can be "故意伤害罪" (intentional injury) if injury caused. Here he punched head; likely caused injury. Also "妨害公务罪" (obstructing public duties) for resisting law enforcement. The act of using violence to resist law enforcement is "妨害公务罪". The fact that he used violence may also be "寻衅滋事罪"? But more appropriate is "妨害公务罪". Also "故意伤害罪" if injury. The fact says he punched head; not mention injury severity. Even if no injury, assault could be "非法侵害他人身体罪"? Actually "故意伤害罪" requires causing bodily injury. If only assault without injury, could be "非法拘禁"? No. Could be "聚众扰乱公共秩序"? No.

Thus likely two crimes: 妨害公务罪; 故意伤害罪. The question: "只写这部分事实直接支持的罪名". The facts support both. So answer: [罪名]妨害公务罪;故意伤害罪<eoa>
